answer: Beacon checks plus compute heartbeats stop fakes at their zenith. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents, who must answer a fresh puzzle in 30 seconds, proving live hardware, not clones wandering idle tasks. A miss gives a sable flag and freezes rewards 20 epochs; a second miss burns the 40-token bond. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 tokens and 100 machines, more than fake rewards pay. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
